description: This file is an HTML source code for a web-based Database Viewer interface, including embedded CSS styles and JavaScript code for dynamic data fetching and interaction.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches the list of databases from the server and displays them in the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the list of databases, resetting the UI state.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Handles expanding or collapsing database entries to show associated tables.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Loads and displays tables for a selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches and displays data for a selected table within a database.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Renders data in a tabular format within the container.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Creates HTML for individual table cell content, including handling for nulls, objects, and long strings.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses cell content for long text or object display.
